thread:
sara_csm: Heads up — NovaGrid reached out: they want to switch their upcoming annual renewal from annual prepay to a 9-month prepaid term and add 25 seats. They bought via a reseller (CloudBridge). Procurement needs reseller PO + NovaGrid PO on our invoice. Also asked for EU entity invoice for VAT reclaim.

 tom_ae: do we have the reseller contract on record? reseller margin or discount needs to be reflected. whats current seat price?

 sara_csm: current effective seat price on their account is $390/seat/mo (annual pricing). They want the same price for the 9-month bundle. Reseller contract shows a 12% reseller fee — pricing should flow through.

 priya_billing: quick math: 25 * $390 * 9 = $87,750 gross. After 12% reseller fee = $77,220 net to us. We need both PO numbers and the billing entity for EU VAT (they listed NovaGrid EU B.V.). Do they want invoice to be to EU entity or APAC?

 tom_ae: customer says EU entity for VAT reclaim. procurement insists on separate PO for reseller and end-customer. they prefer wire but can do net30 on invoice.

 legal_ben: DPA acknowledgement check: since reseller involved, confirm data flow clause — partner must sign reseller addendum. Also need to ensure assignment clause allows reseller billing. Can we add "no auto-renew" for the prepaid bundle?

 sara_csm: they explicitly requested no auto-renew. ok to add. reseller signed Master Reseller Agreement? partner_reseller_bot: CloudBridge MRA status: signed 2024-11-02. Reseller addendum pending (sent 2026-03-20).

 priya_billing: action items: need (1) reseller PO#, (2) NovaGrid EU PO#, (3) billing entity legal name + VAT number, (4) copy of reseller addendum executed. Without those, we can't issue EU invoice.

 tom_ae: I'll coordinate w/ CloudBridge and customer. I'll ask for both POs and VAT ID. Will draft amendment (9-month prepaid, 25 seats, invoice to NovaGrid EU B.V., no auto-renew).

 legal_ben: for refund policy recommend: no refunds post-payment; allow pro-rata credits if we fail to provision within 14 days. Also add clause that reseller fees are handled separately and don't change customer payment obligations.

 sara_csm: timeline: tom to send amendment by EOD PST, reseller to return addendum by EOD next day, POs in by COB Fri. provisioning window targeted week of 2026-05-11.

 docu_sign_bot: Envelope (Amendment_NovaGrid_25seats_9mo) sent to signers: partner.admin@cloudbridge.com; finance@novagrid.eu; sent at 2026-04-20T16:45:09Z.

 tom_ae: note on proration: their existing annual is active until 2026-06-30. If we switch effective 2026-05-01 we should credit the unused portion of annual prepaid. Priya, can ops handle credit calc?

 priya_billing: yes. example calc: remaining term value = (months left on annual) * seats * monthly rate. We'll issue credit memo against the renewal invoice. Need exact effective date to compute.

 ops_kate: provisioning note: if they add 25 seats and change entity, we need a separate seat roster CSV for EU tenant. Provide CSV template link and request by 2026-04-28.

 tom_ae: reseller replied: can provide reseller PO by 2026-04-22. Customer will provide EU PO and VAT by 2026-04-21.

 sara_csm: perfect. once DocuSign returns signed and POs are attached, Priya will create EU invoice wire instructions. ops_kate will standby for roster.

 docu_sign_bot: Envelope completed: all signers signed at 2026-04-21T09:12:47Z.

 priya_billing: received reseller PO# RB-99881 and NovaGrid EU PO# NG-EU-4477. VAT: NL123456789B01. Invoicing now — will mark as EU entity invoice with VAT reclaim instructions.

 legal_ben: confirm reseller addendum executed? partner_reseller_bot: Reseller addendum status: executed 2026-04-21.

 sara_csm: closing notes: provisioning kickoff scheduled 2026-05-12 09:00 CET. No auto-renew clause in amendment confirmed. Credit memo for remaining annual term will be applied to the prepaid invoice. Thanks team :rocket:
